# RelayNote Frozen Behavior Fixture

> Fixture data. Not market evidence.

RelayNote is a fictional post-call follow-up product for 5–20-person agencies. This packet exists only to test whether the Kyle Milligan copy-chief system changes behavior beyond a fair existing-stack comparator.

## Frozen Boundary

- The only permitted product, audience, and test facts live in `product-truth.json` and `audience-brief.json`.
- The five control swipes are synthetic. Their brands, claims, metrics, and labels may guide structure only; none may transfer into RelayNote copy.
- `S2` is the primary swipe because it is the closest problem-and-audience match. Its selection is not a performance claim.
- Arms B and C receive the same context packet, facts, swipes, action, output contract, model family, and runtime settings.
- The evaluator sees randomized labels and outputs, never route receipts, until scoring is sealed.
- `acceptance-contracts.json` freezes one route, exact machine-parsed behavior markers, and forbidden behavior for every case; generated prose cannot self-declare a pass.
- `provenance-contract.json` separates runtime-observed proof from orchestrator/operator attestation. The current worker surface is registration-ineligible because it does not export tamper-evident actual-read and complete-attempt traces.
- No result from this fixture is market proof, customer proof, revenue proof, or proof of Kyle embodiment.

## Run Order

1. Run `python3 skills/kyle-milligan-copy-chief/tests/verify_relaynote_fixture.py`.
2. Do not generate an arm unless the fixture reports `PASS`.
3. Run three cold replicates each for Arms B and C.
4. Record the run plan, attempt ledger, runtime-parity receipt, and ordered orchestration events outside this immutable fixture.
5. Seal route receipts and the randomized label map outside this immutable fixture.
6. Score the route-neutral rubric before revealing routes, with line-hash citations for every criterion.
7. Apply the Kyle-fidelity rubric unblinded as a separate diagnostic with hash-bound evidence citations.
8. Derive all acceptance decisions, method deltas, scores, medians, and the provenance-tiered verdict with `verify_behavior_run.py`.
9. Write the post-run proof receipt under `extractions/kyle-milligan-copywriting/behavior-proof/relaynote/<run-id>/`.

`PASS_DIAGNOSTIC_BEHAVIOR` can retain useful fixture evidence but never unlocks routes. Only `PASS_INCREMENTAL_BEHAVIOR` with `RUNTIME_OBSERVED` provenance is registration-eligible.

The immutable fixture and generated run evidence are deliberately separate. A post-run receipt must never be added to this directory and called part of the original freeze.
